summary.text: Bill Conerly represents District 72 in the Florida House of Representatives, to which Conerly was elected in 2024.

paragraphs.text: The House lists Conerly's residence as Lakewood Ranch and an occupation of civil engineer. Conerly served in the U.S. Navy from 1984 to 1989 and was born in Miami.
Conerly's listed education is a B.S. in engineering from the University of Florida.
